name: Onboarding
description: First-run checklist: a project declares its setup steps, the module tracks each user's progress, auto-detects steps already satisfied elsewhere in the app, and optionally refuses gated routes until the required ones are done.

gate.prompt: Ship the middleware that blocks gated routes until required steps are done?

middleware.label: Yes — an `onboarded` middleware alias the project applies per route

none.label: No — the API reports what is outstanding and the project decides

on.label: Yes — a dismissible bar showing what is left, for any layout
